task_description: Complete Phase 1 of PRODUCTION_READINESS_PLAN.md for the Xplainit framework, one task at a time in order, with the confirmed-broken Python automatic runtime hook (sys.settrace) as the top correctness gate. Empirical verification showed: Task 1.1 (Python bindings) already compiles (doc's '35 errors' is stale) and needs only warning cleanup; Task 1.2 examples custom_filters.rs/event_pipeline.rs already exist and run (needs a real-world example added); Task 1.3 AST is not a stub but get_containing_function is broken (returns None); auto-tracing is genuinely broken (1/3 tests, 0 events) due to '__main__' being excluded in tracer.py; Task 1.4 docs overstate auto-tracing as complete. Plan: baseline -> fix auto-tracing -> clean bindings -> fix AST -> examples+docs. Gate: python test_automatic_tracing.py must reach 3/3 with >0 events, decorator test and cargo test stay green.

verification.summary: cargo build --release clean; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings exits 0; cargo test = 105 passed, 0 failed (76+6 core lib incl 6 new AST tests, 9 integration, 6 python lib incl 2 new behavioural recording tests, plus node/java/c/doc). Python gate: python test_automatic_tracing.py = 3/3 (100%) with 7 events captured (was 1/3 / 0 events before FEAT-002); python xplainit-python/test_decorators.py = ALL DECORATOR TESTS PASSED; repaired secondary xplainit-python/test_automatic_tracing.py runs to completion with events. All 7 xplainit-core examples build and run. Test quality: the new PythonTracer recording test asserts events reach the store (would fail if recording reverted); the 6 AST tests returned None pre-fix and now pass; auto-tracing verified end-to-end. No Dockerfile present, so docker_build skipped.
